# Krishnendu Biswas

> AI systems developer and second-year MBA student at IIM Ranchi and BS in Data Science and Applications student at IIT Madras (Diploma in Programming completed). Builds and operates a personal multi-agent platform on open-source Hermes Agent with human approval gates.

## The story in eight chapters (home page, https://krishnendu.me/)
A management student who learned to code built himself a small team of AI agents that cannot act without his approval, then used that team to ship apps for other students.

1. I build with agents: I am 23 and I study management at IIM Ranchi, in Ranchi. This page shows how a management student ended up running a team of AI agents.
2. Where I started: I study management and learned to code alongside it. The path runs through a programming diploma at IIT Madras, a management degree at IIM Ranchi, and three internships.
3. Learning the models first: Before I let any agent act, I wanted to know how models get things wrong. These projects and one research paper are where I learned that.
4. One assistant became nine: Today the team is nine agents. Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.
5. What the agents actually do: This is what happens between a voice note and a finished task. The risky steps stop and wait for me.
6. What the team shipped: I used the agents to build tools for other students. Two of them are free to use today.
7. Going deeper: The engineering detail lives in six case studies. Each one shows the architecture, and the code stays private.
8. What I believe and where I am going: These are the rules I work by. If they fit what you need, email me.

## Key Verified Facts
- Multi-Agent Operations: 55 recurring scheduled jobs running across 9 agents (8 domain agents plus 1 router).
- Human Approval Gate: Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.
- QualityKiosk Internship: 2 deterministic TypeScript estimation engines (1,027 lines), 136 unit tests (68 Excel parity), 18,456 standardized QA rows.
- Research Publication: 74.19% recall on rare Confused emotion class using RoBERTa with SVMSMOTE, accepted for publication in Springer Nature proceedings, Smart Innovation, Systems and Technologies series, Scopus indexed (FICTA 2026).
- PRISMA Review: Systematic literature review of 29 Scopus articles on generative AI in marketing (10th Pan-IIM WMC 2025).
- ORCID: 0009-0006-1176-1106 (https://orcid.org/0009-0006-1176-1106).
- Certifications: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (Grant Thornton, 2025). Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), earned Jun 2025, expired Jun 2026.
